questions.question: Which storage class is the default for a local variable declared inside a block when no storage class is specified?
options: A. auto
B. extern
C. static
D. register

questions.question: What is a key property of a local static variable?
options: A. It is recreated and initialized on every block entry
B. It retains its value between function calls
C. It must be stored in a CPU register
D. It is always visible from other source files

questions.question: What does extern typically indicate?
options: A. The variable is defined in another place, often another source file
B. The variable must be allocated on the stack
C. The variable is a compile-time constant
D. The variable is always thread-local

questions.question: What is the typical scope of a local variable declared with static inside a function?
options: A. Entire program
B. The containing function block
C. Only the next statement
D. All source files

questions.question: What is the lifetime of a static storage-duration variable?
options: A. Only during one statement
B. For the execution of the program
C. Only until the next function call
D. Only while its block is active

questions.question: What does register suggest to the compiler?
options: A. Request that the variable be stored in a CPU register if practical
B. Force the variable into a CPU register
C. Make the variable constant
D. Make the variable global

questions.question: Can the address of a variable declared with register be obtained using & in standard C?
options: A. Yes, always
B. No, the address-of operator cannot be applied to a register storage-class variable
C. Only if it is global
D. Only when it is a pointer

questions.question: What is the main difference between a local automatic variable and a local static variable?
options: A. Automatic variables have automatic storage duration; local static variables have static storage duration
B. Automatic variables are always global; static variables are always local
C. Static variables cannot be initialized
D. Automatic variables cannot store integers

questions.question: What happens to an uninitialized static-duration integer variable?
options: A. It is initialized to an indeterminate value
B. It is initialized to zero
C. It is always initialized to one
D. It cannot be declared

questions.question: Which storage class can be used to give a file-scope identifier internal linkage when applied appropriately?
options: A. static
B. auto
C. register
D. typedef
